title: {p} & {v} Jambalaya
steps: Brown the {p}, leaving out any shrimp, in a heavy pot, then set aside on a clean plate.
Soften the {v} with the {spice}, then stir in the {s} to coat.
Add the {sauce} and enough stock or water to cover the rice by a knuckle, return the meat, cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in any shrimp for the last 5 minutes, until pink and opaque, and check that the other meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside.
tip: Use less sausage and more peppers, onion and celery, and brown rice if you have the time.
